|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/coloneldyer.html</ref>

As his picture suggests, this man runs the Bunker. He keeps [[Ominous Rumors]] in play, making him almost invaluable in a [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost{{!}}Endor Operations]] deck and allowing you to concentrate on only the [[Establish Secret Base]] effect, which at worst is only sent to your Used Pile. A handy Objective flipping safeguard. Remember that Dyer, being Power 3 Ability 3 is invaluable for [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] Booster draft. Simply add one Biker Scout for a destiny draw, and they can react to his location from next door also. It does make him susceptible to [[Goo Nee Tay]] though in a constructed environment.

Combos: you were expecting something more complex?
